content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"Special Programs - MDA (program element 0603891C) is a research and development effort run by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) under the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"ff838c19a86b3f59"}},{"text":"The program is a classified 'Special Access Program' reported to Congress in accordance with Title 10, United States Code, Section 119 through the annual Special Access Program Budget Justification submission.","citation":{"fact_id":"3c8a8edafe46e1c9"}},{"text":"A second mission narrative notes the program is reported under Title 10, Section 119(a)(1) in the Special Access Program Annual Report to Congress.","citation":{"fact_id":"6d185450fe3a01b9"}},{"text":"The activity is carried out through a single project, MD27 'Special Programs.'","citation":{"fact_id":"fec151b4d1a568f5"}},{"text":"Because it is a Special Access Program, the public budget documents carry only a one-sentence mission statement and no detailed category signal.","citation":{"fact_id":"c5666bada354a3bd"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"The program's total funding is set to rise sharply from $495.57 million in fiscal year 2025 to $821.43 million in fiscal year 2026 — an increase of $325.86 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"f267900a6b254055"}},{"text":"That represents a roughly 66% year-over-year jump between fiscal years 2025 and 2026.","citation":{"fact_id":"132d7aca63f97a05"}},{"text":"The program actually spent $551.03 million in fiscal year 2024, more than its fiscal year 2025 enacted level of $495.57 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"3f3eaa9149eb96ce"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2025 enacted amount was $495.57 million (in USD thousands, $495,570).","citation":{"fact_id":"ea0b5dee9a518cd0"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total of $821.43 million is split between a $498.63 million discretionary request and a $322.8 million reconciliation request.","citation":{"fact_id":"c5666bada354a3bd"}},{"text":"The $322.8 million reconciliation portion is a separate funding stream layered on top of the base discretionary request for fiscal year 2026.","citation":{"fact_id":"93d95c1f72850fc0"}},{"text":"Cumulative prior-year spending on the Special Programs project totals about $4.19 billion, showing this is a long-running investment.","citation":{"fact_id":"fec151b4d1a568f5"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The Missile Defense Agency (MDA) is the organization responsible for the program.","citation":{"fact_id":"4d1d59c7767d68bd"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
